notes: KING/ETH pool with a King of the Hill throne game run entirely by the hook. Every buy and sell pays a fee in ETH on the settled ETH delta (exact-input and exact-output): 25% at pool initialization decaying linearly to 2.5% over 30 minutes, split 92% to the throne pool and 8% to the team wallet 0x39E3414e7a43DE41675e9bEC52F7C9F6ae489CB6, both pull-based through claim(). Fees are held as ERC-6909 ETH claims on the PoolManager, so no swap depends on the manager holding ETH. When the 30 minutes end the throne opens: a single buy through the hook-owned KingRouter whose ETH amount (fee included) is at least the throne price makes the buyer king; the price becomes 1.2x what he paid, halves every hour down to a 0.01 ETH floor, and is the floor while the throne is empty. The king earns 2% of the throne pool per hour, credited per second and claimable after five minutes of valid holding, also after losing the throne. Every reign ending before five minutes forfeits its provisional income, including self-retakes and rival takeovers. Self-retakes preserve the larger of the previous and new token holding requirements. He must keep the required KING: a sell through KingRouter verifies his pre-escrow holdings, accrues valid income and immediately empties the throne. Any swap, claim() or permissionless dethrone() call that finds a deficient balance empties the throne before vesting or accrual; provisional income and the unverified interval since the previous accrual stay in the pool, while vested pending credits survive. A must-take flag in hookData reverts a buy that would not take the throne. Only hookData from KingRouter is trusted to name the buyer; other routers' swaps pay the fee but cannot take the throne, and canonical must-take data from them reverts. Partial exact-input sells refund unconsumed KING to the seller. No owner, no parameters, not upgradeable, not pausable; the hook never acts on transfers or liquidity changes. Launch: pool initialized at sqrtPriceX96 for 1e8 KING per ETH (10 ETH market cap), 90% of supply as single-sided KING liquidity below the current tick, 0% to the requester.
